translations.u161: Users interested in purchasing participate in the Sales Events by submitting binding Bids on the Vehicles, via the Marketplace or through the other channels made available or otherwise accepted by Fleequid for the specific transaction. Unless otherwise provided in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions, Bids must be expressed in EUR and in whole numbers, without decimals. Once submitted, Bids are irrevocable and may not be changed or withdrawn by the Bidder, unless Fleequid, contacted promptly and before the Binding Agreement has been concluded, expressly authorises their change or withdrawal. The provisions of Art. 3 remain unaffected as regards the prior identification and disclosure of the Sales Model applicable to the specific transaction and, in the Commission Sale, of the alternative between Resale and operation as a Pure Intermediary.
translations.u162: The Binding Agreement is concluded: a) in Auctions with a Reserve Price, at the close of the Sales Event, when the Highest Bid is equal to or higher than the Reserve Price; b) in Auctions without a Reserve Price, at the close of the Sales Event, in favour of the Bidder who has submitted the Highest Bid, in accordance with the conditions applicable to the specific type of Auction; c) where the Highest Bid is lower than the Reserve Price, upon acceptance of the Bid or of the subsequent counter-offer in accordance with Art. 10.3; d) in the Buy Now method, upon submission of the Bid corresponding to the price and conditions indicated for that method; e) in the Private Sale, at the moment determined by the conditions laid down for the specific Sales Event, by means of the submission or acceptance of a Bid conforming to the price and conditions made known to the Bidder; f) in the Negotiation and in the Off-Auction Sale, upon acceptance of the Bid or of the counter-offer in accordance with Art. 9.4, letters e) and f). The conclusion of the Binding Agreement entails the assumption of the contractual obligations specific to the applicable Sales Model and does not constitute a Final Award, which, in Auctions only, occurs when the conditions provided for in Art. 12.2 are met. The Sales Contracts governed by these General Terms and Conditions may be concluded verbally or by other means of manifestation of will, and Fleequid does not necessarily require that they be concluded in written form.
translations.u163: Where, at the end of an Auction with a Reserve Price, the Highest Bid is lower than the Reserve Price, no Binding Agreement is concluded immediately and the following provisions shall apply:
translations.u164: in the Commission Sale, Fleequid notifies the Seller of the Highest Bid, who may accept it within 3 (three) days from receipt of the relevant notification. Fleequid may, for justified technical or organisational reasons, grant the Seller a further period, in any event not exceeding 10 (ten) days in total from the notification. Within the same period, as an alternative to accepting the Highest Bid, the Seller may submit a counter-offer to the Bidder, indicating the different price at which it is willing to sell the Vehicle. Acceptance of the Highest Bid by the Seller concludes the Binding Agreement and such amount constitutes the Sale Price to the Buyer. Where the Seller submits a counter-offer, the Bidder may accept it within 3 (three) days from its receipt; upon acceptance the Binding Agreement is concluded and the price indicated in the counter-offer constitutes the Sale Price to the Buyer, the previous Highest Bid ceasing to be of any relevance. In such cases the Seller acknowledges and accepts that its net proceeds may be lower than the MCSP originally indicated;
translations.u165: in Dealer Sales, Fleequid, as seller of the Vehicle vis-à-vis the Bidder, may, within 3 (three) days from the close of the Auction, accept the Highest Bid lower than the Reserve Price or submit to the Bidder a counter-offer at a different price. Acceptance of the Highest Bid by Fleequid concludes the Binding Agreement and such amount constitutes the Sale Price to the Buyer. Where Fleequid submits a counter-offer, the Bidder may accept it within 3 (three) days from its receipt; upon acceptance the Binding Agreement is concluded and the price indicated in the counter-offer constitutes the Sale Price to the Buyer. Any acceptance by Fleequid of a resale price lower than the Reserve Price does not alter the Purchase Price or the other financial terms agreed between Fleequid and the Seller.
translations.u166: Once the applicable time limit has expired without acceptance of the Highest Bid or of the counter-offer, no Binding Agreement is concluded in relation to such proposals.
translations.u167: Fleequid is entitled to verify that the Bidder possesses the personal, technical or professional requirements that may be required for participation in the specific Sales Event or for the purchase of the Vehicle, in particular where the Event is reserved to certain categories of Users or concerns Vehicles subject to specific legal requirements. In cases where such verification is necessary and has not already been completed, the conclusion of the Binding Agreement in the manner provided for in the preceding paragraphs remains conditional upon its positive outcome; until that moment the Bid remains binding on the Bidder. In the event of a negative outcome the Binding Agreement is not concluded and Fleequid notifies the Users concerned accordingly. Fleequid's right to carry out the verification also after the conclusion of the Binding Agreement, in accordance with Art. 16.14, remains unaffected.
translations.u168: Bids other than the one that led to the conclusion of the Binding Agreement remain binding and irrevocable for the Bidders for 15 (fifteen) days from the conclusion of the first Binding Agreement. Such Bids also remain effective during the Payment Period granted to the first Buyer and during any subsequent period of delay, it being understood that they cease in any event to be effective upon expiry of the aforesaid period of 15 (fifteen) days. Where, before the expiry of the aforesaid period, the sale concluded with the first Buyer is cancelled or the relevant Binding Agreement ceases to exist in the cases provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, including on account of non-payment by the Buyer, Fleequid is entitled to proceed with the sale of the Vehicle to one of the other Bidders whose Bid is still valid, even if lower than the Highest Bid of the first Bidder.
translations.u169: In the Commission Sale, where a Reserve Price is provided for, Fleequid may proceed directly on the basis of a Bid equal to or higher than the Reserve Price; where the Bid selected is lower than the Reserve Price, the acceptance procedures provided for in Art. 10.3 shall apply. Where no Reserve Price is provided for, Fleequid may proceed on the basis of one of the Bids still valid in accordance with the conditions applicable to the specific Sales Event, subject to any consents required by the applicable contractual sources. Once the first transaction has been cancelled, the Seller retains no financial entitlement relating to the cancelled sale and is entitled exclusively to what is due in relation to the new transaction actually performed.
translations.u170: In Dealer Sales the decision to accept one of the further Bids still valid rests with Fleequid as seller of the Vehicle. Fleequid may therefore accept one of the aforesaid Bids even where it is lower than the previous Highest Bid or than any Reserve Price, in accordance with Art. 10.3, letter b). Any lower price obtained in the subsequent resale does not automatically alter the Purchase Price agreed between the Seller and Fleequid.
translations.u171: In the cases provided for in letters a) and b) above, the new Binding Agreement is concluded upon Fleequid's notification to the Bidder concerned of the acceptance of the relevant Bid, subject to any consent of the Seller where required in the Commission Sale, or on the basis of Fleequid's own decision in Dealer Sales, without prejudice to the provisions of Art. 10.4 on the verification of requirements. Once the period of 15 (fifteen) days has expired, the Bids that have not given rise to a Binding Agreement definitively cease to be effective and may not subsequently be reinstated as a result of the Cancellation of the Sale or for any other reason.
translations.u172: Upon conclusion of the Binding Agreement, the Bidder acquires the status of Buyer and becomes subject to the binding obligation to pay the Total Amount Due in full in accordance with Arts. 11 and 12. The Binding Agreement produces the contractual effects specific to the applicable Sales Model and to the chosen method of performance, without prejudice to the provisions of Art. 8.8 with regard to the obligations to purchase and to transfer the Vehicle. Payment of the Total Amount Due is not a condition for the conclusion of the Binding Agreement or for the Buyer's payment obligation to arise, but is a prerequisite for the subsequent performance of the transaction in accordance with Art. 12 and, in the case of Auctions, for the Final Award. Upon conclusion of the Binding Agreement the Vehicle acquires Optioned Status pursuant to Art. 11.
translations.u173: Failure to pay the Total Amount Due within the time limits provided for constitutes a breach by the Buyer and produces the effects provided for in Art. 12 on delay, non-payment and Cancellation of the Sale. Non-payment does not affect the conclusion of the Binding Agreement or the Buyer's obligation to pay the sums due, without prejudice to the subsequent exercise by Fleequid of the rights and remedies provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. In the case of Auctions, the fact that the Final Award does not occur does not affect the conclusion of the Binding Agreement that has already taken place.
translations.u175: Upon conclusion of the Binding Agreement the Vehicle immediately acquires Optioned Status. The Optioned Status follows from the conclusion of the Binding Agreement and not from the Proforma being made available. The Optioned Status constitutes exclusively a phase of the sales process managed by Fleequid, subsequent to the conclusion of the Binding Agreement and prior to full performance of the payment obligation and the commencement of the performance phase of the transaction. It does not grant the Buyer any right to choose subsequently whether to purchase the Vehicle, does not constitute an irrevocable offer and does not amount to an option contract pursuant to Art. 1331 of the Italian Civil Code: during Optioned Status the Binding Agreement has already been concluded and the Buyer is already obliged to pay the Total Amount Due.
translations.u176: For as long as it remains in Optioned Status, the Vehicle remains visible on the Marketplace but may not be the subject of new Bids or be made available for purchase by other Users, without prejudice to the provisions of Art. 10.5 as regards the continuing effectiveness of the Bids already submitted before the conclusion of the Binding Agreement.
translations.u177: For as long as the Vehicle remains in Optioned Status: a) the Buyer is obliged to pay the Total Amount Due within the Payment Period; b) where the Vehicle is still at the disposal or under the control of the Seller, the latter is obliged to keep it available for the transaction and, in particular, may not sell or promise it to third parties, withdraw it from the sales process, unilaterally alter its financial terms or otherwise make it unavailable; c) the Seller remains bound by the obligations of custody, preservation, conformity and non-alteration of the Vehicle provided for in Art. 8.12, save as provided in Art. 13; d) the exclusivity provided for in Art. 8.9 remains in force for the entire period during which the Seller is bound by the sale.
translations.u178: Once the Binding Agreement has been concluded, Fleequid makes the Proforma available to the Buyer without delay. The Proforma indicates at least the Buyer as addressee, with the details resulting from registration, the identification of the Vehicle and of the transaction, the Total Amount Due, the expiry of the Payment Period, the bank details of the person or persons to whom payment must be made, the Fleequid entity involved in the transaction and the applicable VAT regime. In the Commission Sale the Proforma also crystallises the chosen method of performance pursuant to Art. 17.1, identifying the person who takes on the capacity of seller and of contractual counterparty of the Buyer, the recipient of the price, the invoicing structure and the resulting warranty regime applicable pursuant to Art. 19.7. Where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, the Proforma sets out separately the identity and details of the Seller, the amount of the price due directly to the latter and the relevant bank details and payment methods, as well as the Commissions, the Fees and any further amounts due to Fleequid, with the respective payment details, so as to enable the Buyer to perform in full from the first day of the Payment Period. In the same case, on the basis of the details that the Seller is required to provide and keep up to date pursuant to Art. 8.5, at the same time as the Proforma is made available and in any event no later than that moment, Fleequid notifies the Buyer of the Seller's details and the Seller of the Buyer's details necessary for invoicing; the relevant invoicing is governed by Art. 17.11. The Proforma does not constitute a contractual source, does not document the assumption of new obligations and may neither alter the conditions applicable to the specific transaction nor remedy the failure to make them known in advance, in accordance with Art. 4.7. The Proforma is made available in the manner provided for in Art. 24.
translations.u179: Save as provided in the following paragraphs, the Payment Period is 3 (three) working days from the Proforma being made available to the Buyer pursuant to Art. 11.4. The Payment Period runs exclusively from that moment and provided that the Proforma contains the elements necessary to enable the Buyer to make the payment. Where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, the same Period applies both to payment of the price due to the Seller and to payment of the Commissions, the Fees and any further amounts due to Fleequid.
translations.u180: The Buyer is not entitled to any deferral or extension of the Payment Period. Fleequid may, however, provide for a different Payment Period or grant an extension thereof in the cases expressly provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, in the Specific Terms and Conditions or in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions applicable to the specific transaction and, in particular, in the event of: a) recourse to a Financing Solution or to a finance lease agreement, in accordance with Art. 22; b) a Vehicle temporarily in use by the Seller, in accordance with Art. 13; c) regulatory or administrative constraints affecting the transaction or the counterparty; d) further special cases expressly provided for in the applicable conditions. Any provision for or grant of a different period concerns exclusively the specific transaction and does not entitle the Buyer to obtain similar deferrals or extensions in subsequent transactions.
translations.u181: The grant of an extension of the Payment Period is at Fleequid's discretion and does not confer any right on the Buyer. Fleequid may, in particular, grant an extension where technical or operational disruptions occur, including those relating to the Marketplace or to the systems used to manage the transaction, which have actually prevented or hindered timely performance, as well as in the other cases in which it considers it appropriate in relation to the specific transaction. The extension is effective only if granted expressly and in writing by Fleequid, through one of the official communication channels provided for in Art. 24, and must indicate the new payment period applicable to the specific transaction. Silence, mere tolerance, the failure to exercise immediately the remedies provided for in these General Terms and Conditions or any communications originating from persons or through channels other than the official ones do not constitute an extension of the Payment Period. Where the extension is granted on account of a disruption that has actually prevented or hindered timely performance, neither the penalties nor the interest provided for as a consequence of delay shall accrue for the period covered by the extension. In the other cases, unless Fleequid expressly provides otherwise in writing in the notice of extension, the grant of the extension entails neither a waiver nor a suspension of the interest, penalties or further sums provided for in these General Terms and Conditions as a consequence of delay, which continue to accrue in accordance with the applicable rules. The extension operates exclusively for the period and for the transaction to which it relates and does not entitle the Buyer to obtain similar extensions in subsequent transactions. The Seller expressly authorises Fleequid to grant the extensions of the Payment Period provided for in this paragraph also where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary and the price of the Vehicle is due directly to the Seller. The grant of the extension, made within the limits and in the manner provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, does not constitute a breach by Fleequid vis-à-vis the Seller, does not extinguish or suspend the obligations incumbent on the latter during Optioned Status and does not entitle it to withdraw the Vehicle from the sale or to dispose of it in favour of third parties. The Seller may not bring against Fleequid any claims for damages or indemnity based solely on the deferral of the performance phase resulting from the extension, save in the event of wilful misconduct or gross negligence on the part of Fleequid and subject to the further mandatory limits laid down by law.
translations.u182: The Vehicle remains in Optioned Status until full performance of the payment obligation and the consequent commencement of the performance phase of the transaction or until the Cancellation of the Sale. In the case of Auctions, full performance also gives rise to the Final Award pursuant to Art. 12.2. The expiry of the Payment Period does not, in itself, cause the Optioned Status to cease, the Vehicle to return to the Seller's full disposal or the Vehicle to be automatically reopened to new Bids; during the period of delay the Vehicle therefore continues to remain in Optioned Status until full payment or the Cancellation of the Sale.
translations.u183: Communications relating to the status of the Vehicle, reminder notices, payment reminders and any other communication that may be sent by Fleequid in relation to the expiry of the Payment Period are merely informative or sent as a courtesy, unless a different function expressly results from these General Terms and Conditions or from the content of the specific communication. Their transmission is not a condition for the sums due to become payable, for the delay to start running or for the application of the interest, penalties and further remedies provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, nor does it entail a waiver by Fleequid of its right to rely on a ground for termination or for Cancellation of the Sale that has already arisen. Furthermore, the sending of payment reminders, requests for payment or other communications after the expiry of the Payment Period does not constitute a revocation or waiver of, or acquiescence in respect of, a termination of the Contract or a Cancellation of the Sale already notified by Fleequid, save for an express declaration to the contrary made in writing by Fleequid through one of its official channels. The failure to receive or to send such communications neither suspends nor defers the Payment Period and does not release the Buyer from the obligation to perform within the applicable time limit. It is understood that any extension of the Payment Period is effective only if granted in the form and under the conditions provided for in Art. 11.7.
translations.u185: The Buyer shall pay the Total Amount Due in full within the Payment Period provided for in Art. 11, by bank transfer to the bank details indicated in the Proforma, unless a different payment method is expressly provided for the specific transaction. Where payment must be made to more than one person, as in the case in which Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary pursuant to Art. 2.6, the Buyer's obligation is deemed to have been performed in full only upon payment of all the amounts due to the respective recipients. Save as otherwise expressly agreed, the Buyer shall make the payment in full, without any set-off against any claims of its own against Fleequid or the Seller and without suspending or refusing payment on account of disputes, whether actual or alleged, relating to the specific transaction or to other contractual relationships. Partial payments are prohibited; in transactions involving more than one recipient, the failure to pay in full any one of the amounts indicated in the Proforma is also deemed to be a partial payment. Any additional costs, expenses or consideration relating to Services the amount of which cannot be determined in advance may be requested and invoiced even at a later stage and shall be paid within 3 (three) days from receipt of the relevant request, unless a different time limit is expressly indicated. The Buyer shall also provide Fleequid, promptly and in any event within 3 (three) days from the conclusion of the Binding Agreement, with all the information and documentation necessary for the invoicing, the registration of the Vehicle and the further formalities relating to the transaction.
translations.u186: Full performance of the Buyer's payment obligation, by means of actual receipt of all the sums included in the Total Amount Due by the respective recipients, gives rise to the commencement of the performance phase of the transaction depending on the applicable Sales Model and the chosen method of performance. In the case of Auctions, full performance also gives rise to the Final Award of the Vehicle. For the purposes of this paragraph, payment made by a third party on behalf of the Buyer is also relevant; in transactions supported by a Financing Solution, payment made by the Financier produces the same effects in accordance with Art. 22, without the mere involvement of the Financier entailing, in itself, the replacement of the Buyer, unless this is expressly provided for in the applicable Specific Terms and Conditions. Where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, the payment obligation is deemed to have been performed in full only when both the price due directly to the Seller and the Commissions, the Fees and any other amount due to Fleequid have been received; the Seller shall notify Fleequid that the price has been received in full within 1 (one) day from receipt thereof and Fleequid may in any event rely on other evidence objectively capable of proving that payment has been made. The Seller's silence is not equivalent to confirmation that the price has been received. Any delay in or omission of the notification by the Seller shall not prejudice the Buyer who demonstrates, by means of bank documentation or other objectively suitable evidence, that the Seller received the payment in full within the Payment Period.
translations.u187: Following full performance of the payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2 the Vehicle acquires the status of sold and the performance phase of the transaction is carried out depending on the applicable Sales Model and the chosen method of performance, including, where provided for, the formalities of invoicing, transfer of ownership, registration, delivery and collection of the Vehicle governed by Art. 16 and by the further applicable provisions. In the case of Auctions such effects follow from the Final Award. The invoicing and the formalities incumbent on the Seller, Fleequid and the Buyer do not affect, unless expressly provided otherwise, the moment at which payment is deemed to have been made or the occurrence of the effects provided for in this article.
translations.u188: In the Commission Sale the Commissions payable by the Seller accrue exclusively upon successful completion of the transaction, which occurs upon full performance of the Buyer's payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2 and the consequent commencement of the performance phase; in the case of Auctions that moment coincides with the Final Award. In the event of non-payment by the Buyer followed by the Cancellation of the Sale, the Commissions payable by the Seller do not accrue and nothing is due from the Seller in that respect, without prejudice to the Fees relating to the Services actually rendered and to any further amounts due from the Seller on a different basis pursuant to these General Terms and Conditions. The Commissions payable by the Buyer, on the other hand, are due as provided for the specific transaction and form part, where applicable, of the determination of the Total Amount Due; failure to pay them constitutes a breach by the Buyer in the same way as failure to pay the other sums due. In the event of delay, non-payment or Cancellation of the Sale for reasons attributable to the Buyer, the Commissions payable by the Buyer remain due from the latter, as do the interest, the penalties, the Fees for the Services rendered and the further amounts provided for in Arts. 12.6, 12.8 and 12.9, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. In Dealer Sales the Commissions specific to the Commission Sale are not due and the financial result of Fleequid's purchase and sale activity does not constitute a parameter for determining the Commissions.
translations.u189: Where the Buyer makes the payment by means of multiple payments not previously authorised by Fleequid, but completes payment in full of the Total Amount Due within the Payment Period, it shall pay Fleequid, by way of penalty, the amount of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each Vehicle concerned, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. The breach provided for in this paragraph is independent of and distinct from delay in payment; the relevant penalty is not taken into account in determining the penalty component relevant for the purposes of the minimum threshold referred to in the last sentence of Art. 12.9.
translations.u190: Once the Payment Period has expired without the Buyer having performed in full the obligation to pay the Total Amount Due: a) the Buyer is in delay and incurs, by way of penalty, the amount of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each day of delay, starting from the first day following the expiry of the Payment Period, without the need for formal notice of default and up to a maximum aggregate amount of €5,000.00 (EUR five thousand/00) for each Vehicle; b) default interest pursuant to Legislative Decree 231/2002 is also due; c) the Vehicle remains in Optioned Status and may not be the subject of new Bids, without prejudice to the provisions of Art. 10.5 with regard to the Bids already submitted and still effective; d) the Seller remains bound by the sale and by the obligations provided for in Arts. 8.9, 8.12 and 11.3 for as long as the Vehicle remains in Optioned Status; e) Fleequid retains the right to receive and accept late payment, without prejudice to the provisions on penalties, interest and further sums due for the delay; the receipt or acceptance of late payment does not, in itself, entail a waiver of the penalties, interest or other amounts already accrued, save for an express written waiver by Fleequid notified through one of the official channels; f) Fleequid may adopt the measures provided for in Art. 12.10.
translations.u191: A period of 7 (seven) days, running from the Proforma being made available pursuant to Art. 11.4, remains applicable, within which Fleequid retains the right to receive late payment under the conditions provided for in Art. 12.6. The aforesaid period includes the ordinary Payment Period of 3 (three) days referred to in Art. 11.5 and does not constitute a further period running from its expiry. Once such period has expired without the Buyer having performed in full, Fleequid may, at its discretion and without the need for any further formal demand or notice of default: a) nevertheless accept late payment, the Commissions payable by the Buyer, the penalties, the interest, the Fees and the further amounts accrued remaining due, save for an express written waiver by Fleequid; or b) proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale on account of the Buyer's breach. The Parties expressly agree that the failure to pay the Total Amount Due in full within the period provided for in this paragraph constitutes a breach which is not of minor importance and entitles Fleequid to declare the Contract terminated pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code, by means of a written notice in which it declares that it intends to rely on this express termination clause; the Cancellation of the Sale ordered pursuant to letter b) constitutes the exercise of that right and produces its effects, in accordance with Art. 14.1. The Cancellation of the Sale is ordered by means of a unilateral declaration by Fleequid notified in writing to the Buyer and to the Seller through the channels provided for in Art. 24 and takes effect from the moment of notification. Until that moment the Contract is not automatically dissolved, the Vehicle remains in Optioned Status and the Seller remains bound as provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. The mere expiry of the period of 7 (seven) days does not prevent Fleequid from subsequently accepting late payment, for as long as the Cancellation of the Sale has not been notified. Until full payment or, if earlier, until the Cancellation of the Sale takes effect, default interest and the further amounts due as a consequence of the delay continue to accrue; the daily penalty referred to in Art. 12.6, letter a), continues to accrue only until the maximum aggregate amount provided for therein is reached. The reaching of such maximum amount results exclusively in the cessation of the accrual of further amounts by way of daily penalty and does not affect the Commissions, the Fees, the default interest, the further amounts due or the consequences of the Cancellation of the Sale provided for in these General Terms and Conditions.
translations.u192: Following the Cancellation of the Sale on account of the Buyer's breach: a) the Optioned Status of the Vehicle ceases vis-à-vis the defaulting Buyer and Fleequid may proceed in accordance with Art. 10.5 vis-à-vis the other Bidders whose Bids are still valid and binding; b) where Fleequid does not avail itself of one of the Bids still effective pursuant to Art. 10.5, or where there are none, the Vehicle may be marketed again by Fleequid by means of a new Sales Event, including under a different Sales Model, in compliance with Arts. 3, 8.6 and 8.8 and with the financial terms applicable in the relationship with the Seller; c) the Seller ceases to be obliged to keep the Vehicle reserved for the defaulting Buyer, without prejudice to the marketing and sale commitment undertaken pursuant to Art. 8.8 and to the further obligations provided for in these General Terms and Conditions; d) the daily penalty provided for in Art. 12.6, letter a), ceases to accrue on the date on which the Cancellation takes effect, the amounts accrued up to that moment remaining definitively due, together with the default interest accrued; e) the amounts provided for in Art. 12.9 remain due from the Buyer; the Commissions payable by the Seller for the cancelled transaction, on the other hand, do not accrue, pursuant to Art. 12.4; f) any Security Deposit provided by the Buyer may be retained and applied to the sums due in accordance with Art. 6.3, with any excess being returned within the time limits provided for therein; g) the Cancellation produces the effects provided for in Art. 6 on User Classification, where the relevant conditions are met, and allows the adoption of the measures provided for in Art. 12.10; h) Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damage remains unaffected; i) the defaulting Buyer may not assert any right or claim over the Vehicle, over its subsequent sale to another Bidder or to a third party, over the price of the subsequent transaction or over any difference, positive or negative, compared with the price of the cancelled sale. The common restitutionary and financial effects are governed by Art. 15.
translations.u193: In the event of Cancellation of the Sale on account of delay or failure to make full payment attributable to the Buyer, the following remain definitively due to Fleequid: a) the Commissions payable by the Buyer, where provided for the specific transaction, as established in Art. 12.4; b) the daily penalty referred to in Art. 12.6, letter a), accrued up to the date on which the Cancellation of the Sale takes effect, as well as the default interest accrued; c) in the Commission Sale, both where Fleequid operates by means of Resale and where it acts as a Pure Intermediary, a further penalty in an amount equal to twice the Commissions payable by the Buyer, determined on the basis of the Commissions applicable to the specific transaction, so that the aggregate amount due in respect of Commissions and of this penalty is equal to three times the amount of the Commissions; d) a further penalty of €1,000.00 (EUR one thousand/00) for each Vehicle covered by the Binding Agreement subsequently cancelled; e) the Fees relating to the Services already rendered and any other amount accrued on a separate basis pursuant to these General Terms and Conditions. In Dealer Sales, since no Commissions under the Commission Sale are due from the Buyer, the penalty referred to in letter c) does not apply; the amounts referred to in letters b), d) and e), on the other hand, remain due. Where the conditions provided for in Art. 13 are met, the conversion of the Advance Payment into a penalty pursuant to Art. 13.6 also remains unaffected. The sums provided for in this paragraph are due on separate bases and may be cumulated within the limits permitted by law. Any Security Deposit provided constitutes exclusively security for the Buyer's obligations and may be applied to the sums due in accordance with Art. 6.3, without constituting a further basis for any charge. Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damage remains unaffected, limited to the part exceeding what has already been satisfied by means of the penalties provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. Where the sum of the penalties referred to in letters b), limited to the daily penalty, c) and d) and, where applicable, of the penalty resulting from the conversion of the Advance Payment pursuant to Art. 13.6 is lower than 5% of the Sale Price to the Buyer of the Vehicle that is the subject of the cancelled sale, the penalty component due in total is supplemented exclusively up to that threshold, which operates as a financial floor and not as a further cumulative sanction. For the purposes of the comparison and of the supplement provided for in the preceding sentence: (i) the basis of calculation consists exclusively of the Sale Price to the Buyer of the Vehicle that is the subject of the cancelled sale, excluding the Total Amount Due, the Commissions, the Fees and any other ancillary amount; (ii) only the penalties specific to the Buyer's breach indicated above are relevant; (iii) the Commissions payable by the Buyer, the Fees, the default interest, the Security Deposit retained or applied, the reimbursements of costs and expenses and the compensation for further damage are not relevant. This provision applies to all Sales Models; in Dealer Sales the comparison is made solely with the penalties applicable therein, and the penalty referred to in letter c) may be neither introduced nor taken into account.
translations.u194: From the occurrence of the delay or non-payment, and for its entire duration, Fleequid may at its discretion restrict or suspend the operation of the Buyer's profile, including by preventing the submission of new Bids or access to certain Sales Events. Where Fleequid accepts late payment, it may restore the operation of the profile, where appropriate maintaining a different deposit regime or a different User Classification pursuant to Art. 6. In the event of Cancellation of the Sale on account of non-payment, Fleequid may maintain or tighten the restriction, up to and including the blocking of the Buyer's profile. The measures provided for in this paragraph, the User Classification and the consequent deposit regime referred to in Art. 6, as well as the Cancellation of the Sale, are separate mechanisms that may be applied cumulatively. The restriction or suspension of the operation of the profile does not dissolve the Binding Agreement, does not affect its effectiveness and does not release the Buyer from the obligations already undertaken, including the obligation to pay the Total Amount Due and the further amounts due pursuant to this article. The measures provided for in this paragraph are independent of the measures that may be adopted pursuant to Arts. 5.6 and 5.7 and are not subject to the conditions and time limits provided for therein.

review: u162, u177, u180, u190, u191, u192, u193: '(a), (b)…' → 'a), b)…' — enumerazioni interne allineate all'IT v9, ai rinvii 'letter a)' e a tutti gli altri blocchi EN (k02-k09); invariati i romani (i)-(iii) di u193.
u164: 'Fleequid notifies the Highest Bid to the Seller' → 'Fleequid notifies the Seller of the Highest Bid' — reggenza corretta di 'notify' in inglese britannico.
u164: 'Within the same time limit' → 'Within the same period' — 'medesimo termine' rinvia al termine appena reso con 'a further period'; un solo sostantivo per lo stesso termine.

u167: 'subjective, technical or professional requirements' → 'personal, technical or professional requirements' — 'subjective' è un falso amico (in inglese = opinabile); 'requisiti soggettivi' sono i requisiti relativi alla persona.

u177: 'in the possession or under the control of the Seller' → 'at the disposal or under the control of the Seller' — 'disponibilità' non è 'possesso'; resa allineata a k06 ('at the disposal of, the Seller').
u177: 'obligations of safekeeping, preservation' → 'obligations of custody, preservation' — stessa formula dell'art. 8.12 usata in k07 ('custody, preservation, conformity and non-alteration').
u177, u190: 'bound to the sale' → 'bound by the sale' — preposizione corretta e allineamento a k06 (art. 13).
u182: 'the Vehicle to return to the full availability of the Seller' → "the Vehicle to return to the Seller's full disposal" — calco eliminato, coerente con u177.

u183: 'reminders, payment reminders' → 'reminder notices, payment reminders'; 'sending of reminders, requests for payment' → 'sending of payment reminders, requests for payment' — 'promemoria' e 'solleciti' tenuti distinti e 'sollecito' reso sempre 'payment reminder' (v8 EN 10.3).
u186: 'within 1 (one) day from collection' → 'within 1 (one) day from receipt thereof' — 'incasso' del prezzo; 'collection' nel documento è il ritiro del Veicolo (art. 16).
u190, u191: 'maximum total amount' → 'maximum aggregate amount' — allineato ai rinvii allo stesso tetto in k06 e k07 ('maximum aggregate amount provided for in Art. 12.6, letter a)').
u191: 'a breach of not minor importance' → 'a breach which is not of minor importance' — stessa formula dell'art. 1455 c.c., ma grammaticalmente corretta (aggiornato anche new_terms).

u172, u175, u176, u177, u181, u182, u190, u191: 'in the / acquires the / during the Optioned Status' → senza articolo — uso degli altri blocchi ('remains in Optioned Status', k03 e k06); l'articolo resta dove il termine è soggetto o oggetto ('The Optioned Status constitutes…').
